summary: Iteration-6 frontend e2e via Playwright on https://jni-project-test.preview.emergentagent.com/arc/. All 4 acceptance areas PASS: (1) Receive Barang modal end-to-end on /arc/orders, (2) REPORT AR Excel download from /arc/recap, (3) Invoice single + bulk Excel downloads from /arc/invoices, (4) Per-Issuer settings section on /arc/settings with persistence after edit + reload.

test_results_detail.auth_and_orders_list: PASS — login operation/operation123 → /arc/orders renders data-testid=orders-list-page; 46 unreceived AWBs visible with receive-btn-{awb_number}.
test_results_detail.receive_modal_flow: PASS — Clicked receive-btn-AWB-202606-0052 → data-testid=receive-modal opened. All 9 fields PRESENT (receive-date, receive-name, receive-polis, receive-asuransi, receive-spsi-check, receive-forklift-check, receive-work-type, receive-mode, confirm-receive-btn). Default date = today (2026-06-15). SPSI/Forklift amount inputs are HIDDEN initially and SHOWN after checking their respective toggles. work-type options exactly ['Kirim Barang','Dismantle Barang','Relokasi Barang']. mode options exactly ['Air','Trucking','Konsul']. 'Nilai AWB (Grand Total)' label visible with amount (Rp 11.100). Submit → modal closes, toast shown (visible in screenshot), and receive-btn-AWB-202606-0052 no longer exists in DOM after the page refresh.
test_results_detail.report_ar_export: PASS — /arc/recap renders, data-testid=export-report-ar-btn PRESENT, clicking triggered download REPORT_AR_ALL.xlsx (matches REPORT_AR_*.xlsx pattern).
test_results_detail.invoice_exports: PASS — /arc/invoices renders, data-testid=bulk-export-btn PRESENT with label 'Export Excel (20)'. After selecting 1 invoice → label becomes 'Export Excel (1)' and click downloads 'Invoice_INV-202606-0020.xlsx' (single format). After selecting 2 invoices → label 'Export Excel (2)' and click downloads 'Invoice_Bulk_2026-06-15.xlsx' (bulk format).
test_results_detail.settings_per_issuer: PASS — /arc/settings as admin shows 'Per Issuer — Signer / Alamat / NPWP' section with all 6 expected rows (setting-signer_/address_/npwp_ × PT. Abirama Mitra Pradana/Pratama). Edited signer_PT. Abirama Mitra Pradana → 'TEST_SIGNER_QA_<ts>' and saved; after page reload the value persisted correctly.

minor_observations: On the unreceived AWB I tested (AWB-202606-0052, customer 'TEST_Customer_a2bbfb'), the receive-name field defaulted to EMPTY rather than auto-populating from consignee. The spec says 'auto from consignee'. Cause is almost certainly that this seed AWB has no consignee_name / contact_pic on the order — the modal already does the lookup. Real customer orders should populate fine, but worth a quick sanity check that OrdersList.js opens the recv form with order.consignee_name (or whichever field) as default. Not blocking — confirm-receive-btn does enforce required.

Could not detect the green toast via [role=status]/.toast selectors (likely react-hot-toast uses a different class). Screenshot does show the 'Invoice ter-export' green toast rendering, so this is just a selector caveat for future tests, not a UX bug.
Each invoice row's checkbox toggle <button> has no data-testid. Adding e.g. data-testid={`invoice-toggle-${i.id}`} on the toggle button would make automated select-N flows simpler.
action_items: (POLISH) Add data-testid='invoice-toggle-{id}' on the per-row select <button> in Invoices.js to make bulk-select flows trivially testable.
(VERIFY) Confirm that receive-name default-fills from a real order's consignee_name when one exists — TEST_ seed customers don't have it, so I couldn't validate the auto-fill path.
critical_code_review_comments: OrdersList.js receive modal correctly hides SPSI amount and Forklift amount inputs until their checkboxes toggle on — verified visually and via DOM is_visible().
Receive flow correctly REMOVES the receive-btn-{awb_number} after success (verified post-submit DOM query returned null). This is the right UX: prevents double-receive.

Invoices.js bulk-export-btn correctly routes to single-export endpoint when one row is selected and bulk endpoint when 2+, producing distinct filename patterns (Invoice_*.xlsx vs Invoice_Bulk_*.xlsx). Excellent.
Settings.js Per-Issuer section renders all 6 seeded keys and the PUT path persists after reload — matches iter-5 backend test for signer flowing into Invoice Excel.
seed_data_creation: Marked AWB-202606-0052 as received via real UI flow (work_type=Kirim Barang, mode=Trucking, spsi=50000, forklift=75000). Also persisted signer_PT. Abirama Mitra Pradana to a TEST_SIGNER_QA_* value — main agent may want to revert this to the production signer name before release.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter-4/5/6 feature surface is verified end-to-end. Settings signer for PT. Abirama Mitra Pradana was overwritten to a TEST_SIGNER_QA_* value during persistence verification — restore via /arc/settings UI or directly via PUT /api/settings/signer_PT. Abirama Mitra Pradana if release artifact (Invoice Excel) needs the production signer.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — no bugs found in this iteration. The receive-name auto-fill 'miss' is purely a test-data limitation (TEST_ seed customer has no consignee name field set).
